project: The Arabic Tongue · Coptic restoration layer · Arabic ↔ Hieroglyphic Egyptian ↔ Coptic
note: Coptic is the SPOKEN third witness — it restores consonants the consonantal hieroglyphic script dropped (flagship لسان↔ns↔ⲗⲁⲥ). Most entries confirm already-attested Egyptian cognates; the Coptic adds evidence, not new claims. * marks a reconstructed Egyptian ancestor (standard historical-linguistics convention). Coptic lemmas from Crum / KELLIA.

entries.reading: س-ن fine-stream + inner-resonance = the tongue; Coptic restores the ل dropped in hieroglyphic ns — metathesis closed
ن-ف-س inner-resonance + parting + flow = breath-as-soul; Coptic nife "to breathe" is near-identical
entries.retraction_note: nfsw form unsourced; the published lemma is nfi̥ (TLA 83380). See readings/egyptian.md

entries.reading: م-gathered mass + و-binding flow = the held-yet-flowing substance
م-gather + و-bind + ت-completion = the final gathering-and-sealing
ي-extension binding the م-gathered mass = the sea
ط-heavy spreading + b = the pressed clay/brick; طوب↔ⲧⲱⲱⲃⲉ is an attested loan into Arabic
و+س-خ bound extension piercing outward to width; same root as واسخ (dual-face)
ن-ف-ر inner-resonance parting-through and flowing = the radiant-fine
ق-firm + ʿ-depth = the firm settled ground/bottom
f-ʿ Afroasiatic serpent-root; the gliding-cover gesture
ب-n what was sealed-inside released into outward resonance = emerging-into-light
ج-gather + س-flow + ر-run = the gathered crossing that runs across
ج-gathered-surfacing + ي-gentle extension forward = arrival
ه-soft breath + descent = the gentle falling-down
ح-warm-containment + ك-sealed-precision = wisdom held secret
ح-containment + ط-heavy spreading = settling-down-into-rest
ش-front-spread + ن-nasal gathering = the smelling gesture
س-م-ر streaming-gathering that runs together = the late-talking companion
entries.retraction_note: Crum CD 339b glosses this Coptic form "moustache", not companion; the Egyptian smr companion match stands on TLA 856044 alone. See 04-cross-linguistic/readings/coptic.md

entries.reading: ش-wide spread + ن-inner resonance = the encircling enclosure
س-ن the matched-pair-by-shared-fine-source nucleus
ن-ف inner-resonance + parting-the-breath = the organ where breath parts (metathesis ʾnf↔fnḏ)

entries.gloss: to become, grow, come into being

م-ر-ح the passing-running grease; smeared/anointing
م-binding relational place-marker
ج/g-gathering-surfacing = coming-upon/gathering (Coptic g→č palatalization)
ش/s-extending-flow running inward = the drinking-in of liquid
س-م streaming-gather = the fatty gathered cream
ح-containment + ل-bridge + q = the encircling throat-ring
ر/rō the opening/loop — the opened ring
ف-parting + ل-q = the splitting-open (Coptic pōrč "divide")
the creating/forming sense of ḫpr; overlaps شبّ (same Coptic šōpe)
ح-l-b the milking; Coptic erōte shares no consonant with حلب — reconstructed bridge only
pr "house" → Coptic pēi; Arabic بيت is a parallel dwelling-stem
